examName: Configuring and Operating Microsoft Azure Virtual Desktop
note: Domains and weights follow Microsoft's published skills-measured outline for AZ-140, 'Skills measured as of July 20, 2026'. This is the most lopsided blueprint in the catalogue: the infrastructure domain alone carries 40-45%, so the paper puts 26 of its 60 questions there. Always check learn.microsoft.com for the current official breakdown before your exam, as Microsoft periodically revises exam blueprints.

domains.name: Plan and implement an Azure Virtual Desktop infrastructure
subtopics: Assess network capacity and speed requirements and design session host network configuration
Plan and implement RDP Shortpath, RDP Multipath, and quality of service policies
Plan and implement Azure Private Link for Azure Virtual Desktop and troubleshoot connectivity
Plan storage for user data and implement storage for FSLogix components
Implement storage accounts, file shares, and Azure NetApp Files for Azure Virtual Desktop
Recommend resource groups, subscriptions, management groups, and an operating system for session hosts
Recommend a licensing model and plan a host pool architecture for performance and capacity
Create host pools and session hosts in the portal and automate creation with PowerShell, CLI, ARM, and Bicep
Configure host pool and session host settings, including client access licensing
Create and modify session host images, use Azure VM Image Builder, and manage image lifecycle and Azure Compute Gallery

domains.name: Plan and implement identity and security
subtopics: Select an identity scenario across AD DS, Microsoft Entra ID, and Microsoft Entra Domain Services
Plan and implement Azure RBAC and Conditional Access policies for Azure Virtual Desktop
Plan and implement authentication options including passwordless, smart card, and multifactor authentication
Manage roles, groups, and rights assignments on session hosts and configure Microsoft Entra single sign-on
Manage session host security with Microsoft Defender for Cloud and Defender Antivirus
Configure Defender for Endpoint onboarding and scanning options for session hosts
Implement network security with user-defined routes, network security groups, and Azure Firewall
Configure Azure Bastion or just-in-time VM access for administrative access
Implement Windows threat protection including App Control for Business and Controlled Folder Access
Implement confidential VMs and Trusted Launch security features for session hosts

domains.name: Plan and implement user environments and apps
subtopics: Recommend FSLogix configuration and configure Profile Containers and ODFC containers
Configure FSLogix Cloud Cache and implement application masking
Choose an Azure Virtual Desktop client and a deployment method, and troubleshoot clients
Configure device redirection, multimedia redirection, printing, and Universal Print
Configure user settings through Intune policies or Group Policy
Configure RDP properties on a host pool and session timeout properties
Implement Start VM on Connect and assign personal desktops
Create and configure application groups, assign users, and publish RemoteApps
Implement Microsoft 365 Apps, OneDrive, Microsoft Teams, and browsers on session hosts
Configure dynamic application delivery with App attach and create application packages

domains.name: Monitor and maintain an Azure Virtual Desktop infrastructure
subtopics: Configure log collection and analysis for session hosts
Monitor Azure Virtual Desktop with Azure Monitor and customise Insights workbooks
Optimise session host capacity and performance
Implement autoscaling in host pools
Monitor and manage active sessions and application groups
Recommend an update strategy for session hosts
Plan and implement disaster recovery and multi-region deployment
Design a backup strategy and configure backup and restore for FSLogix profiles, personal desktops, and images
